title: 'We think' the Iranians and Americans want to negotiate, Egyptian FM says
summary: In an interview with FRANCE 24, Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty said he believed Iran and the United States wanted to negotiate, but called for a "concrete deal" to prevent another escalation.
